subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot plan (Olix Systems)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <prao@olixsys.com>, Alex Kim <akim@olixsys.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot plan (Olix Systems)

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for a productive conversation earlier. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed next step to get a short pilot running:  

Key pain points we heard
- High latency and cost variability on current inference endpoints (especially tail latency for batch processing).
- Hard to enforce consistent quality across model versions and deployments — results drift across environments.
- Need for tighter observability and per-route cost breakdowns for chargeback to internal teams.

Goals you shared
- Reduce 95th-percentile tail latency by ~30% for search-ranking calls.
- Establish a 30-day eval with concrete quality/regression gates on a fixed prompt set.
- Validate cost savings with batching + KV cache over typical workload.

Proposal (Pilot / POC) — high level
- 4-week Pilot: run a dedicated 2-GPU Redwood Dedicated slice against a representative prompt set (we'll provide an eval harness).
- Success metrics: 95p latency <= baseline * 0.7, no more than 3% drop in nDCG on your ranking eval, and >15% per-token cost reduction vs current production.
- Deliverables: evaluation report, prompt/eval suite, rollback and fallback policy, runbook for production handoff.

Action items I propose from our side
1) I'll send a short POC proposal (attached) with scope and preliminary timeline.
2) Stephanie will scope procurement/contract path for a 4-week dedicated trial (MSA/PO if needed).
3) Marcus will prepare access instructions and a lightweight infra checklist so your infra team can provision connectivity.

From your side
- Confirm owners for evaluation (who will own metrics and who will own infra access).
- Provide a sample of anonymized request traces (or a synthetic workload) we can use to size the environment.
- Confirm whether we should run in us-west-2 or us-east-1.

Attachments: Olix_POC_Proposal_v1.pdf (scope + timeline), access-checklist.txt (temp creds & network notes).

If this aligns, I can kick off an internal readiness call Friday and loop your infra owner.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Priya Rao <prao@olixsys.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot plan (Olix Systems)

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap. That all looks good at a high level. A few clarifications/questions before we lock dates:  

- Owners: I'll be the program owner for the evaluation; infrastructure lead will be Alex Kim (cc'd). Please loop Alex for the network/access checklist.
- Dataset: We can produce an anonymized sample of production traces (20k requests) by early next week; does that timeline work?
- Evaluation metric: nDCG threshold sounds reasonable — can you confirm how you measure nDCG in the eval harness (is it strict exact-match or top-k relevance)?
- Region: us-west-2 preferred for latency reasons.

One more ask from procurement: we typically need a one-page SOW plus a short trial addendum instead of a full PO for trials under $15k. If you can route that via Stephanie that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — excited to see a concrete plan.

—Priya
Priya Rao
Head of ML Platforms, Olix Systems
prao@olixsys.com | +1 628-555-0199

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot plan (Olix Systems)

Thanks Priya — great, and us-west-2 works. Quick notes addressing your questions:  

- nDCG: our harness calculates nDCG@10 using the relevance judgments you provide in the prompt-eval CSV. We'll include a short README in the drive link that shows the exact calculation (ranked relevance, discounting as standard).
- Traces: 20k sample is perfect — that will let Marcus size the Dedicated slice and validate caching behavior.
- SOW/trial addendum: Stephanie, can you prepare a 1-page SOW + trial addendum template for Olix (trial cap $12k)? If possible, drop an editable doc link.

Pilot kickoff outline (week-by-week) — if that helps:
Week 0 (1–3 days): access + infra checklist, connectivity test, ingest sample traces.
Week 1: baseline measurements on current model variant; run initial eval on sample prompt set.
Week 2: deploy Redwood Dedicated slice, enable batching + KV cache, run smoothing/rollout.
Week 3: full run of prompt-eval suite, compare metrics, perform 1–2 rollback/fallback tests.
Week 4: final report, handoff notes, cost modeling and next-step recommendations.

Owners
- Olix: Priya (program), Alex (infra), ML owner TBD from your ranking team.
- Redwood: Connor (SE lead), Marcus (infra/config), Stephanie (commercial & SOW).

I've shared the POC proposal and access-checklist in the attachment and on the drive link included in metadata. When you send the 20k traces please also include a sample of any evaluation labels you use for nDCG so we can preconfigure the harness.

Connor
